_comment: Host guardrails (layer E, host side). Enforced in code by harness/guardrails.py. The MCP server's own controls are separate and authoritative.

rules.name: imsi
rules.why: Subscriber identities must not be sent to the LLM provider; no tool needs them.

rules.name: iccid
rules.why: SIM serials are not needed by any tool.

rules.name: card_number
rules.message: For your security, please don't share card numbers here. I've not sent your message.
rules.why: Payment card data must never reach the model (PCI scope).

rules.name: instruction_like
rules.why: Direct injection by the signed-in user only affects their own session; the server enforces access anyway. Logged for review.

output._grounded_identifiers: An identifier may appear in the final answer ONLY if a tool returned it verbatim in this turn. The server decides who sees full numbers (pii:read); anything else (hallucinated, echoed from elsewhere) is redacted.
